Whole-building occluder grouping, orthographic/perspective projection, foreground depth, render-boundary timing, restoration and multi-camera visibility leases
Actual collision-resolved locomotion direction, visual−Z basis, synchronized cardinal blending and controller/profile migration
Included Blender direction clips and FBX reports reviewed; source contact sheet visually inspected

checks.camera_static_review: Capture stores full position decomposition, Euler rotation, vertical lens and offset; explicit authored framing is marked before Setup. Keep After Play records edit-time GlobalObjectIds, accepts only preexisting saved-scene components, consumes one pending request and resolves after Play. Repeated setup adopts manually edited scene pose before snapping.
checks.occlusion_static_review: All candidate groups tested, not only nearest; player full renderer bounds plus capsule/padding; includes colliderless meshes and loaded scenes; renderer-bounds projection is conservative. LateUpdate plus own-camera URP beginCameraRendering/Built-in onPreCull checks occur before rendering. Callback subscriptions are paired. Original rendering flags preserved with owner leases; epoch protects stale caches after subsystem reset. Materials, activation and colliders remain intact.
checks.direction_static_review: SimpleDirectional2D cardinal subtrees inside existing Speed Idle/Run blend in Base/Arms states. Runtime projects actual post-CharacterController velocity after turn-pivot correction onto visual forward/right. ModelForwardYaw=180 is included. Legacy controller and optional profile/override migrate as copies; repeated Setup reuses directional edits.
checks.blender_review: 13 clips,42 bones,24 meshes and6 embedded textures according to current reports. Seven old action curve hashes unchanged; new leg local translation0/scale1 and loop seams exact. Contact sheet inspected: distinct backward/sideward poses without visible hinge stretching. Adjacent half-blend and FBX roundtrip checks reviewed. Source authored left+X maps project Unity+X visual-left at model−Z forward; Unity playback still needs manual confirmation.

notes: Scene/Game aspect differences change horizontal extent while captured vertical framing remains. Physical camera lens shifts/custom projection matrices are unsupported.
Runtime spawned scenery must carry IntercomOccluder or call RefreshScenery; conventional mesh bounds must enclose the rendered geometry.
Occluder bounds are deliberately conservative and may hide a building slightly before geometric contact with the player silhouette.
Four cardinal cycles are blended for diagonals; Unity interpolation and subjective gait appearance still need in-editor review.

required_manual_checks: Capture Scene View outside Play, save, Play/stop/reopen and confirm framing; move robot with independent aim
Use Keep Follow Settings After Play, stop and confirm only original camera changed; Undo restores prior view
Run Setup Mobile Prototype twice after camera/house/controller edits: no duplicate components or authored-value resets
Place a multi-part building between camera and robot, including noCollider mesh; all relevant parts hide immediately and restore after clearing; physics remains solid
Hold aim fixed while moving backward/left/right/diagonally; verify clip direction and support phase; release movement against wall
Inspect new clips and directional blends in Unity Animator; compare left/right at ModelForwardYaw180
Test landscape phone build, two fingers, app focus changes and 16:9/20:9 screens
